outcome.outcome: Materials that work in the lab become makeable in tonnes, so fusion first walls, radiative cooling coatings and high-temperature ductile ceramics stop being demonstrations and become deployable.
outcome.rationale: Their description lists concrete blocked applications and names cost of scaled synthesis, not discovery, as the obstacle.

ai_types.rationale: The stated gap is scaled synthesis and processing, which is manufacturing capability rather than a search or prediction problem.
Process-parameter optimisation for scale-up is an iterative make-and-measure loop that closed-loop platforms can run.

measurability.rationale: Cost per kilogram at a stated property specification is the direct and decisive quantity.

outcome.outcome: Crystallisation becomes predictable enough to plan, removing the trial-and-error step that currently gates structure determination for hard molecules.
outcome.rationale: Their description names computational models of crystal growth as the route to guiding experiment.

ai_types.rationale: Crystal structure and polymorph prediction is an active, benchmarked learned-prediction problem.
High-throughput crystallisation screening is already automated in structural biology facilities.

measurability.rationale: Crystallisation success rate and predicted-versus-observed polymorph are directly scorable, with blind tests already run in the field.

outcome.outcome: Materials can be specified by required engineering property and found, rather than discovered and then checked for usefulness, at industrial cost and scale.
outcome.rationale: Their description states the core challenge as inability to reliably design and manufacture materials meeting specific engineering requirements.

ai_types.rationale: Inverse materials design over property targets works now; their own capability list pairs it with property prediction and self-driving labs.
Iterative self-driving materials labs are named explicitly in their capability set and are operating today.

measurability.rationale: Candidates screened per unit time, hit rate against a property specification and cost per validated material are all countable.

outcome.outcome: Element supply stops setting material cost, because separation gets cheaper and constrained elements become substitutable by design.
outcome.rationale: Their description reframes the critical minerals problem as a scientific bottleneck in acquisition, concentration and substitution.

ai_types.rationale: Separation chemistry and non-neodymium magnet design are both searches over composition with a hard performance target.
Lanthanide separation ligand screening is a bench-scale formulation loop of exactly the kind closed-loop platforms run.

measurability.rationale: Separation factor, energy per kilogram and magnet energy product without neodymium are direct performance quantities.

notes: Materials is the clearest 'AI is working now' field in the map, and the primary types are design and autonomous experimentation rather than LLM work. All four tier-1.
